verdict.rationale: Neon's docs state that its SQL Editor AI features share only the database schema with the AI provider ('no actual data is shared') and that its AI assistant draws on public docs/GitHub content 'without ingesting PII,' which implies limited exposure of customer data to AI tooling — but there is no explicit statement or toggle guaranteeing customer data is never used to train AI models across the platform (e.g. AI Gateway, MCP server, or Functions data flows). Missing for 10: an explicit no-training-on-customer-data policy statement, an opt-out control, and third-party/independent verification of these privacy claims.
